subject.title: Plugin/core version drift after upgrade causes silent channel failure

question: For direct package-manager core upgrades that leave trusted official plugins stale, should OpenClaw warn and degrade readiness, automatically reconcile eligible plugins, or refuse Gateway startup?
rationale: The remaining fix changes upgrade and pin semantics: automatic repair may overwrite intentional pins, while fail-closed startup may create unnecessary outages, so repository intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Warn And Degrade Readiness
options.body: Emit an actionable startup/readiness warning and surface the same diagnosis in channel/provider failures without changing stored plugin pins automatically.

options.title: Auto-Reconcile Eligible Official Plugins
options.body: At startup, update only trusted official records that retain default/latest intent while preserving explicit versions, tags, and third-party sources.

options.title: Refuse Startup On Drift
options.body: Treat trusted official plugin/core mismatch as a startup error until the operator updates or removes the stale plugin.

recommendation.title: Warn And Degrade Readiness
recommendation.body: Emit an actionable startup/readiness warning and surface the same diagnosis in channel/provider failures without changing stored plugin pins automatically.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin updater and install-selection history makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the permanent direct-upgrade and pin-policy boundary.
